1.consolidated_definition: med. Cantidad que debe pagar el asegurado antes de que la empresa aseguradora aporte la estipulada por contrato. Desvío semántico, usual. DRAE 2001: . que puede ser rebajado, descontado. Efectivo enero próximo, los cerca de 600,000 beneficiarios de Medicare en la Isla pagarán $110 de deducible por servicios médico ambulatorios y además pagarán $11.60 adicionales por tal cubierta, que ascenderá a $78.20 mensuales (El Nuevo Día, 14-12-04)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Medical term: Amount that the insured must pay before the insurance company contributes the amount stipulated by contract. Semantic deviation, common usage. DRAE 2001: Capable of being reduced or deducted. As of next January, approximately 600,000 Medicare beneficiaries in Puerto Rico will pay a deductible of $110 for outpatient medical services and will also pay an additional $11.60 for such coverage, which will amount to $78.20 monthly (El Nuevo Día, December 14, 2004).
